organization.name: Shopify Inc.
organization.notes: Company founded/platform launched in 2006; predecessor snowboard store dates 2004. Current investor page verifies Nasdaq and TSX SHOP. Bessemer participation dates 2010; its portfolio still references historical NYSE listing, so current exchange taken from Shopify.

pricingTiers.name: Basic
pricingTiers.notes: Current lowest paid full-store card; $29/month annually ×12. Temporary $1 introductory offer excluded. Old /starter URL redirected to trial; no Starter card on current pricing.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the current public pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Grow
pricingTiers.notes: Closest explicitly small-team tier. Annual $79/month ×12; card/payment processing costs separate.

pricingTiers.name: Plus
pricingTiers.notes: Published starting$2,300/month with committed annual or multiyear contract. Annualized reference$2,300×12=$27,600; negotiated terms/commitment duration and payment schedule may vary. Not verified month-to-month pricing.

moats.claim: Its app ecosystem and combined payments, checkout and retail workflows create complementary-network and switching-cost advantages.

productReasons.claim: Unified online, POS and social-channel operations help merchants manage selling across customer touchpoints.
Integrated checkout, payment methods and order tools connect storefront conversion with fulfillment workflows.
POS inventory and customer tools connect physical retail activity to the ecommerce catalog.
